title: PRAISE HIM PRAISE HIM

lines.text: Praise Him when the sun goes down.

chords:
[Verse]
[D]Praise Him, praise Him,
[D]Praise Him in the morning,
[G]Praise Him in the noontime,
Praise Him, praise Him,
[D]Praise Him when the [A]sun goes [D]down.
...[D]Love Him,...Serve,...Meet etc.etc.
